claims: Rec Room is officially shutting down on June 1, 2026.
Rec Room has over 150 million users.
Rec Room announced that high operational costs and shifting market conditions led to the decision to shut down.
Token purchases in Rec Room have already been halted.
Rec Room stated that costs to operate surpassed revenue.
Rec Room stated that they could not find a sustainable path to profitability.
Snap Inc. has acquired select assets from Rec Room, according to reports from The Verge and GeekWire.
Some employees are joining Snap Inc. to work on AR initiatives, according to reports from The Verge and GeekWire.
Rec Room laid off 16% of its staff in March 2025, according to GeekWire.
Rec Room laid off an additional ~50% of its staff in August 2025, according to GeekWire.
As of the announcement, all monetary transactions within Rec Room have been disabled
